title: Measurement
description: The execution or application of a Metric to a particular subject, within a defined context, using an identified measurement method and applicable configuration. A Measurement is distinct from the Metric it applies and from the MeasurementObservation it produces. (CR-MET-001 binding ADR-MET-002; full attribute set in CR-MET-003.)

applies_metric.description: Reference to the dea:PerformanceMetric definition version applied. Cardinality 1:1 (every Measurement applies exactly one Metric). (CR-MET-001 binding ADR-MET-002 decision 6.)

measures_subject.description: Reference to the entity that was measured. Cardinality 1:1 (every Measurement targets one subject). Full source-list extension per CR-MET-007 / ADR-MET-004.

temporal.description: Temporal context placeholder. Full specification in CR-MET-004 (lifecycle) and CR-MET-011 (temporal dimensions).

responsible_party.description: Reference to the responsible party. Full governance object spec in CR-MET-010.

configuration.description: Configuration parameters necessary to reproduce the result. Full specification in CR-MET-003.
